    • get

      protected T get(Arguments arguments)
      Returns the value associated with this argument from a collection of arguments, or null if this argument does not exist in that collection or has no value.

      A key gets the value after its key, parses it, and returns the result. If the key does not appear or has no value after it, the default value is returned.

      Specified by:
      get in class Argument<T>
      Parameters:
      arguments - the collection of arguments
      Returns:
      the value associated with this argument if it is present in the collection, or null if it is not
